item.title: OpenViking: ByteDance's Context Database for Agent Memory
item.description: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents from the Viking team at ByteDance’s Volcengine. It keeps everything an agent knows (documents, long-term memories and skills) in one virtual filesystem under viking://, writes a short summary for every directory, and lets agents read context with file commands like ls, tree, find and grep. Memories come from sessions: when a chat is committed, OpenViking extracts them in the background as Markdown files you can open and edit.
